pli-tv-kd16:1.3.4: atha kho rājagahako seṭṭhī ekāheneva saṭṭhi vihāre patiṭṭhāpesi.

pli-tv-kd16:4.4.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.3: addasā kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.4: disvāna caṅkamā orohitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.5: nisajja kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.9: haṭṭho udaggo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.1: atha kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa ānupubbiṃakathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhammeva ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.6: evameva anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.8: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.10: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.13: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.14: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.15: adhivāsetu ca me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.17: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.2: anāthapiṇḍikena kira gahapatinā svātanāya buddhapamukho saṅgho nimantitoti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.3: atha kho rājagahako seṭṭhī anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.4: “tayā kira gahapati svātanāya buddhapamukho saṅgho nimantito.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.6: demi te gahapati veyyāyikaṃ yena tvaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa bhattaṃ kareyyāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.7: “alaṃ gahapati. atthi me veyyāyikaṃ yenāhaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa bhattaṃ karissāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.9: “anāthapiṇḍikena kira gahapatinā svātanāya buddhapamukho saṅgho nimantito”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.10: atha kho rājagahako negamo anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.11: “tayā kira gahapati svātanāya buddhapamukho saṅgho nimantito.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.13: demi te gahapati veyyāyikaṃ yena tvaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa bhattaṃ kareyyāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.15: atthi me veyyāyikaṃ yenāhaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa bhattaṃ karissāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.16: assosi kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.17: “anāthapiṇḍikena kira gahapatinā svātanāya buddhapamukho saṅgho nimantito”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.18: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.19: “tayā kira gahapati svātanāya buddhapamukho saṅgho nimantito.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.21: demi te gahapati veyyāyikaṃ yena tvaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa bhattaṃ kareyyāsī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.23: atthi me veyyāyikaṃ yenāhaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa bhattaṃ karissāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati tassā rattiyā accayena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.4: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.6: “adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.9: atha kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.1: tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bahumitto hoti bahusahāyo ādeyyavāco.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati rājagahe taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena sāvatthi tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.3: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati antarāmagge manusse āṇāpesi
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.4: “ārāme ayyā karotha vihāre patiṭṭhāpetha. dānāni paṭṭhapetha.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.6: so ca mayā bhagavā nimantito iminā maggena āgacchissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.7: atha kho te manussā anāthapiṇḍikena gahapatinā uyyojitā ārāme akaṃsu, vihāre patiṭṭhāpesuṃ, dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.8: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati sāvatthiṃ gantvā samantā sāvatthiṃ anuvilokesi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.10: yaṃ assa gāmato neva nātidūre nāccāsanne gamanāgamanasampannaṃ atthikānaṃ atthikānaṃ manussānaṃ abhikkamanīyaṃ divā appākiṇṇaṃ rattiṃ appasaddaṃ appanigghosaṃ vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppanti’.
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.1: addasā kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati jetassa rājakumārassa uyyānaṃ
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.2: gāmato neva avidūre nāccāsanne gamanāgamanasampannaṃ atthikānaṃ atthikānaṃ manussānaṃ abhikkamanīyaṃ divā appakiṇṇaṃ rattiṃ appasaddaṃ appanigghosaṃ vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.3: disvāna yena jeto rājakumāro tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā jetaṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.10: “yato tayā ayyaputta aggho kato, gahito ārāmo”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.11: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati sakaṭehi hiraññaṃ nibbāhāpetvā jetavanaṃ koṭisantharaṃ santharāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.1: sakiṃ nīhaṭaṃ hiraññaṃ thokassa okāsassa koṭṭhakasāmantā nappahoti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati manusse āṇāpesi
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.6: “na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati, yathāyaṃ gahapati tāva bahuṃ hiraññaṃ pariccajatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.14: mahatthiko kho pana evarūpānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pasādo”ti
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.16: atha kho jeto rājakumāro tasmiṃ okāse koṭṭhakaṃ māpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.17: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati jetavane vihāre kārāpesi, parivenāni kārāpesi, koṭṭhake kārāpesi, upaṭṭhānasālāyo kārāpesi, aggisālāyo kārāpesi, kappiyakuṭiyo kārāpesi, vaccakuṭiyo kārāpesi, passāvakuṭiyo kārāpesi, caṅkame kārāpesi, caṅkamanasālāyo kārāpesi, udapāne kārāpesi, udapānasālāyo kārāpesi, jantāghare kārāpesi, jantāgharasālāyo kārāpesi, pokkharaṇiyo kārāpesi, maṇḍape kārāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.4: tena kho pana samayena manussā sakkaccaṃ navakammaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.5: yepi bhikkhū navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhenti tepi sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.6: atha kho aññatarassa daḷiddassa tunnavāyassa etadahosi
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.7: “na kho panedaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati, yathā ime manussā sakkaccaṃ navakammaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.9: atha kho so daḷiddo tunnavāyo sāmaṃ cikkhallaṃ madditvā iṭṭhakāyo cinitvā kuḍḍaṃ uṭṭhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.10: tena akusalakena citā vaṅkā bhitti paripati.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.12: tatiyampi kho so daḷiddo tunnavāyo sāmaṃ cikkhallaṃ madditvā iṭṭhakāyo cinitvā kuḍḍaṃ uṭṭhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.13: tena akusalakena citā vaṅkā bhitti paripati.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.1: atha kho so daḷiddo tunnavāyo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.2: “ye imesaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ denti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ te ime ovadanti anusāsanti tesaṃ ca navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhenti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.4: na maṃ koci ovadati vā anusāsati vā navakammaṃ vā adhiṭṭhetī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa daḷiddassa tunnavāyassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.10: “kinti nu kho vihāro khippaṃ pariyosānaṃ gaccheyyā”ti
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.2: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.4: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmassa gahapatino vihāraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno navakammaṃ dadeyya”
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.7: saṅgho itthannāmassa gahapatino vihāraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno navakammaṃ deti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.8: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa gahapatino vihāraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno navakammassa dānaṃ, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.10: dinno saṅghena itthannāmassa gahapatino vihāro itthannāmassa bhikkhuno navakammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.11: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.1: atha kho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antevāsikā bhikkhū buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa purato purato gantvā vihāre parigaṇhanti, seyyāyo parigaṇhanti

pli-tv-kd16:6.1.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito gantvā vihāresu pariggahitesu, seyyāsu pariggahitāsu seyyaṃ alabhamāno aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.

pli-tv-kd16:6.2.3: ‘idaṃ amhākaṃ upajjhāyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ bhavissatī”ti.

pli-tv-kd16:6.2.7: ‘idaṃ amhākaṃ upajjhāyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ bhavissatī’ti.

pli-tv-kd16:6.2.13: “yo bhagavā khattiyakulā pabbajito so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.15: “yo bhagavā brāhmaṇakulā pabbajito so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.17: “yo bhagavā gahapatikulā pabbajito so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”

pli-tv-kd16:6.2.33: “yo bhagavā sotāpanno so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.37: “yo bhagavā arahā so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.39: “yo bhagavā tevijjo so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.41: “yo bhagavā chaḷabhiñño so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.4: tittiro ca makkaṭo ca hatthināgo ca.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.5: te aññamaññaṃ agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā viharanti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.6: atha kho bhikkhave tesaṃ sahāyānaṃ etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.7: “aho nūna mayaṃ jāneyyāma. yaṃ amhākaṃ jātiyā mahantataro taṃ mayaṃ sakkareyyāma garuṃ kareyyāma māneyyāma pūjeyyāma tassa ca mayaṃ ovāde tiṭṭheyyāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.8: atha kho bhikkhave tittiro ca makkaṭo ca hatthināgaṃ pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.10: “yadāhaṃ sammā chāpo homi, imaṃ nigrodhaṃ antarā satthīnaṃ karitvā atikkamāmi aggaṅkurakaṃ me udaraṃ chupati.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.12: atha kho bhikkhave tittiro ca hatthināgo ca makkaṭaṃ pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.14: yadāhaṃ sammā chāpo homi chamāyaṃ nisīditvā imassa nigrodhassa aggaṅkurakaṃ khādāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.16: atha kho bhikkhave makkaṭo ca hatthināgo ca tittiraṃ pucchiṃsu
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.19: tato ahaṃ phalaṃ bhakkhitvā imasmiṃ okāse vaccaṃ akāsiṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.22: atha kho bhikkhave makkaṭo ca hatthināgo ca tittiraṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.24: taṃ mayaṃ sakkarissāma garukarissāma mānessāma pūjessāma tuyhañca mayaṃ ovāde patiṭṭhissāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.25: atha kho bhikkhave tittiro makkaṭañca hatthināgañca pañcasu sīlesu samādapesi. attanā ca pañcasu sīlesu samādāya vattati.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.26: te aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.27: evaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave tittiriyaṃ nāma brahmacariyaṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.1: te hi nāma bhikkhave tiracchānagatā pāṇā aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharissanti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.2: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā vihareyyātha.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.3: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya. atha kho taṃ bhikkhave appasannānañceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā”ti
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.6: “anujānāmi bhikkhave yathāvuḍḍhaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.7: na ca bhikkhave saṅghikaṃ yathāvuḍḍhaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:6.5.2: pure upasampannena pacchā upasampanno avandiyo, anupasampanno avandiyo, nānāsaṃvāsako vuḍḍhataro adhammavādī avandiyo, mātugāmo avandiyo, paṇḍako avandiyo, pārivāsiko avandiyo, mūlāya paṭikassanāraho avandiyo, mānattāraho avandiyo, mānattacāriko avandiyo. abbhānāraho avandiyo.
pli-tv-kd16:6.5.5: pacchā upasampannena pure upasampanno vandiyo, nānāsaṃvāsako vuḍḍhataro dhammavādī vandiyo, sadevake bhikkhave loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vandiyo.
pli-tv-kd16:7.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā saṅghaṃ uddissa maṇḍape paṭiyādenti, santhare paṭiyādenti, okāse paṭiyādenti.
pli-tv-kd16:7.3: saṅghikaññeva ‘bhagavatā yathāvuḍḍhaṃ anuññātaṃ, no uddissakatanti’ buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa purato purato gantvā maṇḍapepi parigaṇhanti’ santharepi parigaṇhanti, okāsepi parigaṇhanti
pli-tv-kd16:7.4: ‘idaṃ amhākaṃ upajjhāyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
pli-tv-kd16:7.5: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito gantvā maṇḍapesu pariggahitesu, santharesu pariggahitesu okāsesu pariggahitesu okāsaṃ alabhamāno aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:7.6: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ukkāsi.
pli-tv-kd16:7.11: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd16:7.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd16:7.13: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antevāsikā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd16:7.14: saṅghikaññeva bhagavatā yathāvuḍḍhaṃ anuññātaṃ no uddissakatanti buddhapamukhassa saṅghassa purato purato gantvā maṇḍape parigaṇhanti, santhare parigaṇhanti, okāse parigaṇhanti:
pli-tv-kd16:7.15: idaṃ amhākaṃ upajjhāyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:8.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhattagge antaraghare uccāsayanamahāsayanāni paññapenti. seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:8.2: āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ goṇakaṃ cittakaṃ paṭikaṃ paṭalikaṃ tūlikaṃ vikatikaṃ uddalomiṃ ekantalomiṃ kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:8.8: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhattagge antaraghare tūlonaddhaṃ mañcampi pīṭhampi paññapenti.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.3: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.5: “adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.7: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.8: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.10: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.11: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.12: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.14: “tena hi tvaṃ gahapati jetavanaṃ āgatānāgatassa cātuddisassa saṅghassa patiṭṭhāpehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.15: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato paṭissutvā jetavanaṃ āgatānāgatassa cātuddisassa saṅghassa patiṭṭhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:9.2.1: atha kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
pli-tv-kd16:9.2.24: atha kho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa ājīvakasāvakassa mahāmattassa saṅghabhattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.2: āyasmā upanando sakyaputto pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojanaṃ ānantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.4: atha kho so mahāmatto ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojane bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti,
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.7: nanu nāma labbhā aññatrāpi nisinnena yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitunti”
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa mahāmattassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.9: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.10: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojanaṃ ānantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpessati.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.13: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, upananda pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojanaṃ ānantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpesi bhattaggaṃ kolāhalaṃ ahosī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.16: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojanaṃ ānantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpessasi.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.23: sace vuṭṭhāpeti pavārito ca hoti. ‘gaccha udakaṃ āharā’ti vattabbo
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.25: no ce labhetha, sādhukaṃ sitthāni gilitvā vuḍḍhatarassa bhikkhuno āsanaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.26: natvevāhaṃ bhikkhave kenaci pariyāyena vuḍḍhatarassa bhikkhuno āsanaṃ paṭibāhetabbanti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū gilāne bhikkhū vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.4: ‘mayaṃ āyasmante vuṭṭhāpessāmā’ti pariggahetvā vuṭṭhāpetvā ṭhitake muñcanti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.9: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.13: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū lesakappena senāsanaṃ paṭibāhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū aññataraṃ paccantimaṃ mahāvihāraṃ paṭisaṅkharonti
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.3: addasaṃsu kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiye bhikkhū vihāraṃ paṭisaṅkharonte.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.9: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.18: “uṭṭhethāvuso amhākaṃ vihāro pāpuṇātī”ti. kupitā anattamanā gīvāyaṃ gahetvā nikkaḍḍhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.22: “ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā amhe saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.23: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.24: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā bhikkhū saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhissantī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.25: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. …pe…
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.26: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā saṅghikā vihārā bhikkhū nikkaḍḍhantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.30: “na bhikkhave kupitena anattamanena bhikkhu saṅghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhitabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcahaṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ senāsanagāhāpakaṃ sammannituṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.5: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, gahitāgahitañca jāneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.7: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo, yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.9: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ senāsanaggāhāpakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.13: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno senāsanagāhāpakassa sammati so tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.16: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti .
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ bhikkhū gaṇetuṃ, bhikkhū gaṇetvā seyyā gaṇetuṃ, seyyā gaṇetvā seyyaggena gāhetunti.”
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.11: gahite anubhāge añño bhikkhu āgacchati na akāmā dātabbo”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.12: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nissīme ṭhitassa senāsanaṃ gāhenti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.16: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū senāsanaṃ gahetvā sabbakālaṃ paṭibāhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave vassānaṃ temāsaṃ paṭibāhituṃ utukālaṃ pana na paṭibāhitunti.”
pli-tv-kd16:11.4.8: aparajjugatāya pavāraṇāya āyatiṃ vassāvāsatthāya antarāmuttako gāhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sāvatthiyaṃ senāsanaṃ gahetvā aññataraṃ gāmakāvāsaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.4: “ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā upanando sakyaputto bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.5: sacāyaṃ idha vassaṃ vasissati sabbeva mayaṃ na phāsu bhavissāma.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.8: “nanu tayā āvuso upananda sāvatthiyaṃ senāsanaṃ gahitanti.”
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.10: “kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso upananda eko dve paṭibāhasī”ti,
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.13: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.14: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto eko dve paṭibāhissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.15: bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā …pe… etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ paṭipucchi
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.16: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda eko dve paṭibāhasī”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.19: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa eko dve paṭibāhissasi,
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.20: tattha tayā moghapurisa gahitaṃ idha mukkaṃ. idha tayā gahitaṃ tatra mukkaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.21: evaṃ kho tvaṃ moghapurisa ubhayattha paribāhiro.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.22: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya. atha kho taṃ appasannānaṃ ceva appasādāya pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti. vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. ādissa ādissa āyasmato upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.3: “bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti, vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, ādissa ādissa āyasmato upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇāmā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.5: te ca bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.6: āyasmā upāli ṭhitako’va uddisati therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāravena.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.8: tattha therā ceva bhikkhū kilamanti āyasmā ca upāli.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.10: “anujānāmi bhikkhave navakena bhikkhunā uddisantena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ uccatarake vā dhammagāravena.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.11: therena bhikkhunā uddisāpentena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ nīcatarake vā dhammagāravenā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bahū bhikkhū āyasmato upālissa santike ṭhitakā’va uddesaṃ paṭimānentā kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.8: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū samānāsanikā ekamañce nisīditvā mañcaṃ bhindiṃsu. ekapīṭhe nisīditvā pīṭhaṃ bhindiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.11: tivaggo pi mañce nisīditvā mañcaṃ bhindi, pīṭhe nisīditvā pīṭhaṃ bhindi
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū asamānāsanikehi saha dīghāsane nisīdituṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.15: “anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā paṇḍakaṃ mātugāmaṃ ubhatobyañjanakaṃ asamānāsanikehi saha dīghāsane nisīditunti.”
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.19: “anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ pahoti ettakapacchimaṃ dīghāsananti.”
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena visākhā migāramātā saṅghassa atthāya sālindaṃ pāsādaṃ kārāpetukāmā hoti hatthinakhakaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.3: “kinnu kho bhagavatā pāsādaparibhogo anuññāto kiṃ ananuññāto?”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.6: tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa ayyakā kālakatā hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.7: tassā kālakiriyāya saṅghassa bahuṃ akappiyabhaṇḍaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.8: āsandi pallaṅko goṇako cittako paṭikā paṭalikā tūlikaṃ vikatikaṃ uddalomikaṃ, ekantalomikaṃ kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ kambalaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ, ajinappaveṇi kadalimigappavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.10: “anujānāmi bhikkhave āsandiyā pāde chinditvā paribhuñjituṃ, pallaṅkassa vāle bhinditvā paribhuñjituṃ, tūlikaṃ vijaṭetvā bibbohanaṃ kātuṃ, avasesaṃ bhummattharaṇaṃ kātunti.”
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ gāmakāvāse āvāsikā bhikkhū upaddutā honti āgantukagamikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ paññapentā.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.3: “etarahi kho mayaṃ āvuso upaddutā āgantukagamikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ paññapentā.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso sabbaṃ saṅghikaṃ senāsanaṃ ekassa dema
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.6: te sabbaṃ saṅghikaṃ senāsanaṃ ekassa adaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.11: “kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso saṅghikaṃ senāsanaṃ vissajjethā”ti.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.13: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti: –
